task:
Open LibreOffice Impress.

1、Then set 'Always save as' for 'Presentation' to 'PowerPoint 2007-365 (.pptx)', enable 'Always create backup copy', enable 'Save AutoRecovery information every', and set the AutoRecovery interval to 7 minutes.

2. Change 'Measurement unit' to 'Inch'.

After confirming all dialogs, make sure the preferences are flushed to ~/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu. The verifier cannot read the preferences until LibreOffice has exited cleanly.

verification.description: AutoSave interval property has been written to the LibreOffice registry
AutoSave interval is set to 7 minutes
Default save filter for Impress has been set
Default save filter for Impress is PowerPoint 2007-365 (.pptx)
Impress measurement unit set to Inch (enum value 8)
